title: Story premise EDU019: The Missing Return Path
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (everyday science). Hook: One wire reaches the lamp. What is still missing? Takeaway/theme: A simple closed circuit includes a complete conducting path.
description: A lamp designer wants a toy circuit symbol to light, but draws only a wire from the source to the bulb. Completing the return path in the simulation closes the circuit and lights the indicator.
